_about: Soundtrack list for the Music tab. Every track is free music: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, credited on each entry. Audio is hosted on the site in parts (audio/music/*.partN, joined in the browser). Game files: Assets/Resources/MenuMusic.mp3 + Assets/Resources/Music in the private repo. Rule: only CC0 / public domain / CC BY (with credit) music here, no copyrighted songs.
